facts.text: Foerost was a Core planet orbited by the famous Foerost Shipyards, which was one of the Galactic Republic's largest and oldest shipyards.

evidence.quote: Foerost was a Core planet orbited by the famous Foerost Shipyards, which was one of the Galactic Republic's largest and oldest shipyards.

facts.text: Although a city, Hajibar, existed on Foerost at the time of the Clone Wars, the planet was uninhabited during most of its history.

evidence.quote: Although a city, Hajibar, existed on Foerost at the time of the Clone Wars, the planet was uninhabited during most of its history.

facts.text: The planet was renowned for its shipyards, located in high orbit.

evidence.quote: The planet was renowned for its shipyards, located in high orbit.

facts.text: The planet was originally a vassal colony of Kaikielius, but had achieved full Republic membership by 11,000 BBY.

evidence.quote: The planet was originally a vassal colony of Kaikielius, but had achieved full Republic membership by 11,000 BBY.

facts.text: During the Tionese War, the Republic Navy was headquartered at Foerost, the site of the Republic's largest shipyard.

evidence.quote: During the Tionese War, the Republic Navy was headquartered at Foerost, the site of the Republic's largest shipyard.

facts.text: Centuries later, in 3996 BBY, during the Great Sith War, a combined Krath/Mandalorian fleet captured 300 Galactic Republic warships from the shipyards for use in an assault on the Republic capital Coruscant.

evidence.quote: Centuries later, in 3996 BBY, during the Great Sith War, a combined Krath/Mandalorian fleet captured 300 Galactic Republic warships from the shipyards for use in an assault on the Republic capital Coruscant.

facts.text: Decades later, in 3959 BBY, Sith Lords Darth Revan stole a major Republic fleet from the shipyards, triggering the Jedi Civil War.
entities: Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia

evidence.quote: Decades later, in 3959 BBY, Sith Lords Darth Revan stole a major Republic fleet from the shipyards, triggering the Jedi Civil War.

facts.text: Millennia later, the shipyards were purchased from the Republic by the Techno Union.

evidence.quote: Millennia later, the shipyards were purchased from the Republic by the Techno Union.

facts.text: During the Separatist Crisis, the Techno Union secretly joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems with the objective to overthrow the Republic.

evidence.quote: During the Separatist Crisis, the Techno Union secretly joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems with the objective to overthrow the Republic.

facts.text: When the Clone Wars erupted, the Techno Union provided the Foerost Shipyards to the Separatist war effort.

evidence.quote: When the Clone Wars erupted, the Techno Union provided the Foerost Shipyards to the Separatist war effort.

facts.text: In response, the Republic blockaded Foerost, expecting the shipyards to decline without access to Separatist supply line.

evidence.quote: In response, the Republic blockaded Foerost, expecting the shipyards to decline without access to Separatist supply line.

facts.text: Contrariwise, Separatist engineers were able to develop and secretly build a fleet of Bulwark-class battleships.

evidence.quote: Contrariwise, Separatist engineers were able to develop and secretly build a fleet of Bulwark-class battleships.

facts.text: After nearly two years of blockade, the Bulwark Fleet was revealed when it broke the siege of Foerost.

evidence.quote: After nearly two years of blockade, the Bulwark Fleet was revealed when it broke the siege of Foerost.

facts.text: After the defeat of the Bulwark Fleet at the Battle of Anaxes, the Republic eventually recaptured Foerost.

evidence.quote: After the defeat of the Bulwark Fleet at the Battle of Anaxes, the Republic eventually recaptured Foerost.
